description: Revenue ← deal.org_id=O1 — FAN-OUT case, must NOT double-count

result.sql_normalized: SELECT SUM(dataset_table_193.amount) AS dataset_table_193_amount FROM (SELECT * FROM `bcfix`.`bc_revenue`) AS dataset_table_193 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM `bcfix`.`bc_owner`) AS dataset_table_188 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM `bcfix`.`bc_deal`) AS dataset_table_190 ON dataset_table_188.bc_key = dataset_table_190.bc_key WHERE dataset_table_193.bc_key = dataset_table_188.bc_key AND dataset_table_190.org_id = 'O1') LIMIT 10000000
